name: Shooting Star
text: Range 8. A Star die: its 6 surges with Power.

name: Hurl Fire
text: Range 6. A Fire die: a 6 sets the target alight.

name: Poison Mist
text: Everyone in a straight line, 2 tiles. A Poison die, and one more for each Poison token on you: casting throws them all off.

name: Icicle Arrow
text: Range 4. An Ice die: a 6 freezes the target a stack.

name: Acid Ball
text: Range 3. An Acid die; the same roll splashes one random creature beside the target, friend or foe.

name: Death Touch
text: A creature beside you. Two Necro dice: a 6 blackens a lost heart.

name: Squall Wave
text: Range 5. A Squall die, and your Rumble dice try to shove the target too.

name: Shining Light
text: Range 6, walls or no. A Radiate die: a 6 makes the target shine.

name: Lifeforce
text: Range 3. A Life die: a 6 grows plants under the target.

name: Quake
text: Every monster beside you. An Earth die, one more against those on rubble.

name: Elektrobolt
text: Range 5. An Elektrik die: each 6 jumps to another monster beside the target.

name: Swirly Eyes
text: Range 3. A Psycho die: on a hit, move the target a tile of your choice.

name: Shadowbind
text: Range 6, walls or no. A Shadow die: a 6 blinds the target.

name: Flame Blast
text: Range 3. Three Fire dice, like the scroll it was learned from.

name: Frost Blast
text: Range 3. Three Ice dice, like the scroll it was learned from.

name: Venom Blast
text: Range 3. Three Poison dice, like the scroll it was learned from.

text: Range 3. Three Acid dice, like the scroll it was learned from.

text: Range 3. Three Necro dice, like the scroll it was learned from.

name: Gale Blast
text: Range 3. Three Squall dice, like the scroll it was learned from.

name: Sun Blast
text: Range 3. Three Radiate dice, like the scroll it was learned from.

text: Range 3. Three Life dice, like the scroll it was learned from.

text: Range 3. Three Earth dice, like the scroll it was learned from.

text: Range 3. Three Elektrik dice, like the scroll it was learned from.
